thread:
maria: Quick sync 1h  final copy sprint for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing updates. Sketch + playbook here: https://tiny.redwood/launch-playbook-v1. Please flag blockers.
aj: Do we want a single hero or three mode-specific heroes? I prefer one unifying headline + three tiles.
kyle: Agreed. One headline simplifies AB tests and SEO. Subheads can call out latency, isolation, control.
sophie: Updated Dedicated tile to clarify SLA/commit language. Also suggested "Reserve capacity" micro-CTA for mid-market. Thoughts?
maria: Good. Use "Reserve capacity" for Dedicated, "Contact sales" for Private, "Start for free" for Hosted.
samir: For inbound routing: capture utm + product_mode in the signup form and route accordingly. Example webhook mapping: { utm_campaign: launch-spring, product_mode: dedicated, route_to: sales-dedicated }
aj: Add a hidden "estimated_monthly_tokens" field so AEs can triage.
kyle: Webinar CTA note: landing needs separate CTA for webinar signup vs product start or we'll cannibalize conversions. Suggest a 2-column CTA block: "Sign up for the launch webinar" + "Start Hosted for free".
sophie: I'll add the wire. Also we should include the benchmark line: "up to 40% lower median per-token latency in our benchmark" with an asterisk and link to methodology (legal to review).
maria: @aj please run benchmark phrasing by legal. We should surface a methodology footnote linking to the repo for transparency.
launch-bot: Reminder: copy freeze in 48h.
samir: Inbound routing mappings I'll paste into the doc: utm_source=twitter -> marketing-inbound; utm_source=organic -> sales-ops; product_mode=private -> enterprise-sales; utm_campaign=webinar -> webinar-ops.
maria: Final asks: 1) webinar follow-up email (recording + 5 bullets + clear next step), 2) tag clicks on "Reserve capacity" vs "Contact sales" for funnel analytics.
kyle: I'll draft the follow-up email with a single CTA to book an AE call.
sophie: I'll prepare two headline variants for A/B: Variant A benefit-first, Variant B cost+reliability. Run 2 weeks post-launch and measure conversion + demo requests.
maria: Thanks team  merging final copy tomorrow AM. Join 9:30 rollout sync if you want to be in the handoff. :white_check_mark:
